title: Real Estate Tracker
noPropertiesDescription: Start building your real estate portfolio by adding your first property.

propertyForm.addPropertyDescription: Enter the details of your property.
propertyForm.editPropertyDescription: Update the details of your property.
propertyForm.name: Property Name
propertyForm.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this property? This will also delete all associated loans.

loanForm.addLoanDescription: Enter the details of your loan or mortgage.
loanForm.editLoanDescription: Update the details of your loan.
loanForm.name: Loan Name

loansDialog.title: Loans for {propertyName}
loansDialog.description: Manage all loans associated with this property.
loansDialog.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this loan?

postponePayments.title: Postpone Loan Payments
postponePayments.description: Temporarily postpone payments for {loanName}. This will extend the loan maturity date and increase the total interest paid.
postponePayments.alertMessage: Postponing payments is typically used during financial difficulties. Interest will continue to accrue during the postponement period.
postponePayments.monthsHint: Maximum 12 months can be postponed at once

anticipatedReimbursement.title: Anticipated Reimbursement
anticipatedReimbursement.description: Make an extra payment on {loanName} to either shorten the loan duration or reduce monthly payments.
anticipatedReimbursement.alertMessage: Making extra payments can save you significant interest over the life of the loan.
anticipatedReimbursement.shorterDurationDescription: Keep the same monthly payment of {monthlyPayment}, but pay off the loan sooner.
anticipatedReimbursement.lowerPaymentDescription: Keep the same end date of {endDate}, but reduce your monthly payments.
anticipatedReimbursement.calculationError: Unable to calculate new parameters. Please ensure you have a valid end date and monthly payment set for this loan.
